references.text: The same formula 'the Lord spoke to Moses and said' is used consistently in the books of Moses to introduce divine commands and revelations.
An identical introductory formula marking that the Lord gives direct instructions to Moses.
The same standard expression for divine communication to Moses, which opens the entire book of Numbers.
The same formula was used earlier in the context of Korah's rebellion, which is the direct background for the event concerning Aaron's staff.
The same chapter, where the Lord first speaks to Moses about the staff test that was to confirm whom He had chosen.
